purpose: Improve homepage discovery of existing Tiling.ca guides and enquiry routes in English and French. Public competitor content is not evidence of ranking causation.

findings.observation: Homepage makes services, products and cost planning visible.
findings.applied: Four early planning routes; three source-scoped pricing previews and the complete pricing library.

findings.observation: Coverage and enquiry stages are explicit.
findings.applied: City/community search linking genuine area pages, property-specific scheduling language, and a three-step project explanation.

findings.observation: Selection and responsibilities such as removal, delivery and disposal are connected to installation.
findings.applied: Material guidance, existing preparation/supply services, a practical enquiry checklist and targeted inspiration links.

guardrails: Preserve contractor positioning and the existing quote endpoint.
Industry ranges remain third-party CAD examples with region and scope notes, not Tiling.ca rates.
Inspiration images are labelled and do not claim completed customer projects.
No invented reviews, certifications, warranties, offices, products in stock or response times.
All 15 service routes, five material guides and prior location/pricing improvements remain accessible.
searchBehavior: Accent-insensitive city, province, region and community matching. Exact city names sort first. Six homepage matches link to local pages; the full directory preserves the search. No-match state retains direct enquiry and directory access.
